name: Sevinne's Reclamation
oracle_text:
Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, you may copy this spell and may choose a new target for the copy.
Flashback {4}{W} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
blocked_sentences: If this spell was cast from a graveyard, you may copy this spell and may choose a new target for the copy.

needs.what: a way for a resolving instant or sorcery's own spell_effects to copy that same spell ("you may copy this spell and may choose a new target for the copy"), with new_targets: copy_spell must be able to name the spell currently resolving, which stack.resolve_top has already popped off the stack before _resolve_spell runs its effects
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_spell (sid, target, new_targets) finds its original through _spell_named_by -> state.stack_item(sid), and the resolving spell is no longer on the stack (resolve_top pops it first), nor does the resolution context bind its own sid -- so a copy_spell inside spell_effects copies nothing. The cast_from_graveyard condition itself works. Moving the copy to a spell_cast trigger (the storm shape) would be a different card: the copy would exist even if the original is countered, and it would be made at cast rather than at resolution
